snippet.title: Chicken Run: Eggstraction | Pre-Order Trailer | UK | PEGI
snippet.description:
Pre-order Chicken Run: Eggstraction now on Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and Steam!

Picking up after Dawn of the Nugget, the story expands with new missions, tougher challenges, and mischievous foes to outsmart. 🐔 🎮
Play as favorites like including Molly, Frizzle, and Fowler
Collaborate in 1–2 player co-op, including co-op–only levels
Watch chaos unfold in cut scenes packed with classic Aardman comedy
 Sneak, puzzle-solve, and lead your flock to freedom!

Pre order now 👉 https://outrightgames.com/games/chicken-run-eggstraction/

#ChickenRunEggstraction
